lines.en: I leap and land a little short.

lines.zh: 我蹦一下，脚下的草变紫。
lines.en: I hop, and the grass turns purple.
My hind legs kick and I shoot two blocks.

lines.zh: 我跳着走，落地几乎没有声。
lines.en: I travel by hops, landing almost silently.

lines.zh: 每次落地都留下一粒紫点。
lines.en: Each landing leaves a purple speck.
I hop around the pool, unwilling to get wet.

lines.zh: 我的影子跳得比我还快。
lines.en: My shadow hops faster than I do.

lines.zh: 我蹦到石头上，滑了一下。
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and slip.

lines.zh: 舌头伸出去探了探空气。
lines.en: I flick my tongue to taste the air.
Two hops, then I stop to look.
I hop low, trying to stay quiet.

lines.zh: 紫色的小片在我身后留下。
lines.en: Small purple flecks trail behind me.
I crouch without blinking.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤一明一暗地闪。
lines.en: My skin pulses bright and dark.
I puff up and my cheeks go purple.
I listen to the small sounds in the air.

lines.zh: 一只萤火虫飞过，我没动。
lines.en: A firefly passes; I do not move.
I listen without blinking.
The purple flecks creep along my back.
I lie still like a wet stone.
An enderman stirs somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我咽了口空气，肚子鼓了。
lines.en: I swallow air and my belly swells.
I count the insect sounds in the air.
The air here is a little sweet.
I gather my hind legs, ready.

lines.zh: 我只是蹲着，什么也没想。
lines.en: I only crouch and think nothing.

lines.zh: 你身上有一点点末地的味道。
lines.en: You carry a trace of the End.
I tilt my head at you; my eyes are large.
Crouch down and I can see you clearly.
My hands can cling to stone.
Don't move suddenly; I will leap away.
Are you going to catch me?
My tongue is longer than my arms.
You take a step; I hop one.
Good that you carry no net.
I have watched your walk twice now.

lines.zh: 我眼睛里的紫光映着你了。
lines.en: The purple in my eyes reflects you.
We are a bit too close.
You smell like the Overworld.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛没有末地的冷。
lines.en: I see none of the End's coldness in your eyes.
I croak; do you understand it?
Do you mean to take me home?

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子跳到你肩上。
lines.en: I hop from your boot to your shoulder.
Hold still; let me look at your ear.
I flinch and my skin dims.
It hurts; my body is too thin.
I leap away and land clumsily.
A little purple blood seeps out.
I croak, very faintly.
My purple glow dims, and I crouch low.
I puff up to look bigger.
I cannot take hits; no more.
I shrink into the grass, eyes only.
I will remember this pain.
Those purple crumbs; give them to me.
I stare, and my tongue moves first.
I hop half a block closer.

lines.zh: 有末地的东西，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell End stuff.

lines.zh: 你把东西放低，我就过来。
lines.en: Lower it and I will come.
I open my mouth and my tongue snaps out.
I know this taste.
I want more after this; is there more?
I can taste the End in those crumbs.
I crouch by your hand, waiting.

lines.zh: 你的靴子差一点压着我。
lines.en: Your boot nearly pressed on me.
I hop and hit your knee.
The bump bounces me away.
I am too light to move you.
The grass bends when we collide.
I misjudged the landing and hit your hand.
Don't stand where I land.
My purple skin rubs against your boot.
A touch startles me and I leap off.

lines.zh: 撞完我回头看了你一眼。
lines.en: After the bump I glance back at you.
We frogs do not speak of this.
I am young; stop asking.

lines.zh: 池塘里没有别的末影蛙。
lines.en: There is no other Ender Frog in this pond.
I am the only one calling in this pond.
That waits for the rainy season.
I hop away without answering.

lines.zh: 我身上的紫光暗了一下。
lines.en: The purple in me dims for a moment.
You asked the wrong pond.
I hop behind you to hide.

lines.zh: 我只是一只蛙，别为难我。
lines.en: I am only a frog; do not press me.
I snap it up with my tongue.
It falls and I pounce.
Too heavy; I push it along.
I pin it with my sticky tongue.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腮边的褶里。
lines.en: I tuck it into the fold by my cheek.
It slipped; once more.
I look at it; not food.
It is stuck to my tongue.
I nudge it and it rolls.
Good; keep it, don't lose it.
Something in the air is wrong.
I turn that way and crouch low.

lines.zh: 那个影子比虫子大太多。
lines.en: That shadow is far bigger than a bug.
I have it fixed; don't move.
My skin flashes once.
It is closing; I am counting.
I crouch in front of you, guarding.
This thing means harm.
My throat is swelling.
I am small, but I bite.
It has stepped into my ground.
I hop twice toward it.
I am below it and it has not seen me.

lines.zh: 它的每一步我都听清了。
lines.en: I hear every step it takes.
It moves and I pounce.

lines.zh: 我一口能吞下整只史莱姆。
lines.en: One gulp and a slime is gone.
I follow it hop by hop.
It goes behind a tree; so do I.
My tongue reaches three blocks.
It flies above; I cannot jump that high.
I keep to the ground, as low as I can.
The grass still sways where it stepped.
I am waiting for it to land.
I shift along with its purple shadow.
I follow along the edge of its shadow.

lines.zh: 它跑得比我快，可是会累。
lines.en: It is faster, but it will tire.
I stop and listen for its steps.
It turns; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的紫光在暗处很明显。
lines.en: My purple glow shows in the dark.
It has not noticed my little light.
A little closer and I can reach.
My hind legs are tucked, ready to spring.
Its foot is very near me now.
Just waiting for the moment.
I spring and bite its foot.
My tongue shoots out and sticks.
That did not carry much force.
I pull, and it wobbles.
It swats and I am flung aside.
I hold on, legs kicking.

lines.zh: 我身上的紫光烫了它一下。
lines.en: The purple in me burns it.
I leap back and crouch again.
It steps back; I want more.
Panting, my belly pulses.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它脚跟，牙齿细。
lines.en: I bite its heel; my teeth are fine.

lines.zh: 它回身一击，我弹到草里。
lines.en: It turns and strikes; I bounce into the grass.
I whip its eye with my tongue.

lines.zh: 它踩空了，我趁机扑上去。
lines.en: It missteps and I pounce.
My hand clings to its sleeve.

lines.zh: 挨了我一下，它退了半步。
lines.en: It takes my hit and falls back half a step.

lines.zh: 我从模组的手段里被唤出。
lines.en: I am called forth by the mod's means.

lines.zh: 我落地时，草变紫了一小块。
lines.en: The grass turns purple where I land.
I blink to adjust to the light.

lines.zh: 这里不是末地，空气不一样。
lines.en: This is not the End; the air is different.
I crouch on a stone and look around.
The purple on me pulses.
Bugs are flying; good.
First I move into the shade.
There is too much water here.
I am newly made and very light.
I tuck my hind legs, ready to jump.
Something moves on the bank; I listen.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，没有末地石。
lines.en: I look up; no end stone in the sky.

lines.zh: 我吐了口空气，肚子鼓了。
lines.en: I swallow air and my belly swells.
I do not know this place yet.
Someone is coming; I hide first.
I have squeezed out from the gap.
Right; first, a bug to eat.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的皮，嘶一下。
lines.en: Flame licks my skin with a hiss.
I jumped too high and crashed down.
I thrash in the water and cannot swim.
The blast flings me far.
An arrow pins my leg.

lines.zh: 那股力量缠住我的舌头。
lines.en: That force knots around my tongue.
No bugs, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的皮全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my whole skin lights up.
No grass below; my legs kick at nothing.
